name.ja: RG 汎用ヒト型決戦兵器 人造人間エヴァンゲリオン 正規実用型 3号機 ESVシールド セット
name.en: RG General Purpose Humanoid Battle Weapon Android Evangelion Regular Practical Type Unit 3 ESVSeal Set

description.ja: 『ヱヴァンゲリヲン新劇場版』より正規実用型 3号機がESVシールドとセットで登場！
description.en: From "Evangelion: New Theatrical Version", the official practical type Unit 3 is now available as a set with ESVSeal!

description.ja: ■「人造人間」という劇中の設定をもとに、ヒトとして自然なアクションポーズの再現を追求。
description.en: • Based on the setting in the play of "androids," we strive to reproduce action poses that are natural for humans.

description.ja: ■「背骨可動」「腕の捻り」などの人間らしい可動性を実現。
description.en: • Realizes human-like mobility such as "moving the spine " and " twisting the arms."

description.ja: ■３号機輸送時の「エヴァンゲリオン専用光学系保護カバー」を初立体化。
description.en: • The first three-dimensional version of the "Evangelion optical system protection cover" used during Unit 3 transportation.

description.ja: ■零号機用の「エヴァンゲリオン専用単独防御兵装 ENCHANTED SHIELD OF VIRTUE」が付属。
description.en: • ENCHANTED SHIELD OF VIRTUE, an exclusive Evangelion defensive weapon, for Unit 0 is included.

description.ja: ■ESVシールド用の零号機ハンドパーツが付属。
description.en: • Includes Unit 0 hand parts for ESVSeal.

accessories.ja: エヴァンゲリオン専用光学系保護カバー×1式
accessories.en: Optical system protection cover for Evangelion x 1 set

accessories.en: Evangelion exclusive defense weapon ENCHANTED SHIELD OF VIRTUE×1

accessories.en: Unit 0 hand parts for Seal × 1 set
